name: r_zl_freeplay_city042_lit_ab_observation_mcw
description: A fresh ordinary observation account installed from a separately native-saved, explicitly artificial local A/B flashlight footing. Player choices may turn the flashlight on and off and make bounded stationary/withdrawal decisions; results are controlled-fixture observations, never natural city-hostile credit.

steps.label: settle_ordinary_artificial_lit_ab_copy
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native-saved artificial A/B copy loads before the ordinary player's first decision

steps.label: operate_ordinary_lit_ab_observation
steps.objective: Use only currently advertised native player owners. Make an ordinary player choice to turn the flashlight on, observe a bounded stationary interval and any player-visible hostile/lighting consequence, then turn it off and observe or withdraw according to the actual World surface. Do not debug, manufacture attention, inject contact/knowledge, or script an outcome. Report the result only as an artificial-fixture on/off observation.
proof_targets: player-selected native on and off light controls
any player-visible hostile behavior, survival choice, or honest absence
invariants: no debug after ordinary account launch
fixture's placement and light-off state earn zero ordinary credit
no natural-city or generalized hostile-attention conclusion
only player-visible native facts support the observation

steps.label: save_and_exit_ordinary_lit_ab_observation
steps.objective: At the honest boundary, use native Save and Quit, native Main-menu Quit, and their native confirmations.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the ordinary A/B observation account saves, returns to main menu, and its owned process exits

evidence_contract.claim: one separate ordinary, controlled-fixture observation can assess a player-selected flashlight on/off contrast without claiming natural hostile behavior
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: native-saved artificial fixture only / zero inherited ordinary credit
evidence_contract.writeback_note: The artificial placement and starting light state are setup evidence only; the ordinary player actions and visible outcomes may support only the labeled A/B observation.
